title: Final Judgment
definition: The final judgment is God’s righteous judgment of all people through Jesus Christ, revealing truth, condemning evil, vindicating righteousness, and displaying divine justice.
summary: Judgment is not arbitrary; it is perfectly holy, truthful, and just. All hidden things will be brought to light, and every person is accountable before God.
christFocus: Christ is both Savior and Judge. Those who are in Him need not fear condemnation, but all are called to repent and trust Him before the day of judgment.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God’s judgment is righteous and comprehensive.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: The Gospel offers refuge from condemnation through faith in Christ.
